### Test service signature nuances more thoroughly

Let's craft direct `protocols.signature` cases:
- ADB CNXN valid; arg1 ignored; version bits; trailing bytes reject; checksum bad; magic bad; length mismatch; unknown command; body invalid UTF8; CNXN empty body; AUTH body arbitrary bytes; length >65535 reject.
- Sync valid XML/binary; wrong keys; empty Value; wrong Request; wrong Key order; trailing data; frame length0; too large; malformed plist; recursion; duplicate keys semantics.
- TCP payload nonempty None.
This tests adapters directly. Let's write.

cat > /workspace/tmp/test_protocols.py <<'EOF'
import sys,struct,plistlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from protocols import signature,adb_packet,CNXN,AUTH
def chk(label,kind,data,expected_none):
 s=signature(kind,data)
 ok=(s is None)==expected_none
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'FAIL '),label,repr(s)[:100])
 return ok
ok=True
# ADB
body=b'banner';pkt=adb_packet(CNXN,0x010203,1,body)
ok&=chk('cnxn valid', 'adb',pkt,False)
s=signature('adb',pkt);assert s==('CNXN','1.2.3','banner')
# arg1 different same sig
s2=signature('adb',adb_packet(CNXN,0x010203,999,body));assert s2==s
# version high bits ignored
s3=signature('adb',adb_packet(CNXN,0x7f010203,0,body));assert s3==s
ok&=chk('auth valid','adb',adb_packet(AUTH,5,6,b'xyz'),False)
assert signature('adb',adb_packet(AUTH,5,6,b'xyz'))==('AUTH',5,6,b'xyz')
ok&=chk('cnxn empty body','adb',adb_packet(CNXN,0,0,b''),False)
ok&=chk('trailing','adb',pkt+b'x',True)
ok&=chk('short','adb',pkt[:10],True)
ok&=chk('unknown cmd','adb',adb_packet(0x12345678,0,0,b''),True)
ok&=chk('bad magic','adb',pkt[:20]+b'\0\0\0\0',True)
bad=bytearray(pkt);bad[20]^=1
ok&=chk('bad checksum','adb',bytes(bad),True)
# declared length mismatch
hdr=struct.pack('<6I',CNXN,0,0,5,sum(body)&0xffffffff,CNXN^0xffffffff)
ok&=chk('length mismatch','adb',hdr+b'abc',True)
# length >65535
hdr=struct.pack('<6I',CNXN,0,0,65536,0,CNXN^0xffffffff)
ok&=chk('length too big','adb',hdr,True)
# invalid utf8
body=b'\xff';pkt=adb_packet(CNXN,0,0,body)
ok&=chk('bad utf8','adb',pkt,True)
# TCP
ok&=chk('tcp empty','tcp',b'',False)
ok&=chk('tcp payload','tcp',b'x',True)
# sync
def frame(obj,fmt=plistlib.FMT_XML):
 b=plistlib.dumps(obj,fmt=fmt);return struct.pack('>I',len(b))+b
good1={'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'1.2'}
good2={'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'Dev'}
ok&=chk('sync xml','sync',frame(good1)+frame(good2),False)
assert signature('sync',frame(good1)+frame(good2))==('sync','1.2','Dev')
ok&=chk('sync binary','sync',frame(good1,plistlib.FMT_BINARY)+frame(good2,plistlib.FMT_BINARY),False)
ok&=chk('sync trailing','sync',frame(good1)+frame(good2)+b'x',True)
ok&=chk('sync one frame','sync',frame(good1),True)
ok&=chk('sync frame len0','sync',b'\0\0\0\0'+frame(good1),True)
ok&=chk('sync wrong key1','sync',frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'x'})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync wrong key2','sync',frame(good1)+frame({'Key':'X','Request':'GetValue','Value':'x'}),True)
ok&=chk('sync extra key','sync',frame({**good1,'Extra':1})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync missing key','sync',frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue'})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync empty value','sync',frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':''})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync nonstr value','sync',frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':1})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync wrong request','sync',frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'Get','Value':'x'})+frame(good2),True)
ok&=chk('sync malformed plist','sync',b'\0\0\0\3bad'+frame(good2),True)
# recursion-ish deeply nested binary?
print('ALL',ok)
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/test_protocols.py
